description: Create a content distribution queue with recurring weekly time slots. Content added with aidelly_add_queue_items publishes in those slots; creating the queue publishes nothing.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

channels.description: Channels to post to from this queue

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

slots.description: Time slots when queue should post

timezone.description: IANA timezone ID for slot times (e.g. America/New_York)

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_create_queue
title: Create Queue
